Job Title:

Junior Software Engineer (KSA-Based, Preferably an Arabic Speaker)

Location:

KSA (On-site)

Employment Type:

Full-time

Department:

AI and Data

Reports To:

Hear of AI and Data

About Insight360:

Insight360 is a forward-thinking consultancy and implementation firm at the forefront of AI and data analytics. With a rich portfolio of over 100 successful projects spanning various industries and global locations, we specialize in guiding organizations towards Smart Decision Support Systems. Our mission is to equip decision-makers with intelligent insights, leveraging a robust methodology that seamlessly integrates data analytics with overarching business strategies and objectives. Renowned for our unwavering commitment to delivering tangible business value, we employ cutting-edge technologies and tools, earning us the esteemed reputation of being a trusted partner in the industry.

THE ROLE

You write production code from your first sprint. You will build the services, APIs, and interfaces that run inside enterprise systems across the UAE and GCC — under the review of architects who read every line, and to engineering standards you will be held to rather than eased into.

We hire juniors for trajectory, not inventory. A long tool list on a CV counts for less than a small thing you built well and can defend under questioning. You will use AI-assisted development tools as a daily instrument and be expected to move fast with them — but speed without judgement is a defect, and you own every line you ship regardless of who or what wrote it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO
• Build and ship features in production services — REST endpoints, backend services, and front-end interfaces — under architect review and to a defined definition of done.
• Write tests as part of the work, not after it — unit and integration tests that a reviewer trusts. Untested code is unfinished code.
• Work in a Git-based pull request workflow — branch, commit cleanly, raise reviewable PRs, respond to code review without ego, and keep CI green.
• Integrate external APIs and data sources — authentication, pagination, retries, rate limits, and failure handling that does not fall over in production.
• Debug across the stack — reproduce, read logs and traces, isolate the root cause, and fix the cause rather than the symptom.
• Use AI-assisted development environments (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery — then review, test, and explain what they produced.
• Document what you build — clear READMEs, API contracts, and honest commit and PR descriptions your teammates can work from.
• Participate in design discussions — ask why a design was chosen, propose alternatives, and learn to argue trade-offs rather than preferences.

MUST-HAVE: ENGINEERING FOUNDATION

Programming. Strong Python — clean, readable, tested code; functions and classes, error handling, packages and virtual environments. Equivalent strength in another language plus demonstrable ability to become productive in Python quickly is acceptable.

APIs & Web Services. REST fundamentals and the ability to build an endpoint end to end (FastAPI, Flask, Django, or Node/Express). HTTP semantics, JSON, status codes, and authentication basics.

Front-End. TypeScript/JavaScript and one modern framework — Angular preferred, React acceptable — with solid HTML and CSS. You should be able to put a working interface in front of a service you built.

Databases. SQL that goes beyond SELECT * — joins, aggregation, indexing basics, and sane schema design. PostgreSQL or SQL Server experience preferred.

Version Control & Tooling. Git in daily use (branching, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts), plus fluency in VS Code or Visual Studio and comfort on the command line.

Computer Science Fundamentals. Data structures, algorithmic complexity, object-oriented design, exception handling, and a working understanding of asynchronous execution and concurrency.

Testing. Hands-on with a unit testing framework (pytest, Jest, or equivalent) and able to say what separates a useful test from a decorative one.

AI-Native Development. You already build with AI coding assistants and can explain, line by line, what the tool produced and why it is correct. The AI wrote it is never an explanation for a defect.

GOOD TO HAVE — SIGNALS OF TRAJECTORY
• Docker fundamentals, or a CI/CD pipeline (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) you set up yourself rather than inherited.
• Cloud exposure — Azure preferred; AWS or GCP equally welcome as evidence you can operate beyond localhost.
• Calling an LLM API from your own code (Anthropic, OpenAI, or open-source models) — a working prototype you can walk us through counts for more than a certificate.
• Message queues, caching (Redis), or any experience with systems that must stay up under load.
• Open-source contributions, side projects, hackathons, or competitive programming — anything that shows you write code when nobody is grading you.

HOW WE ASSESS

We will not ask you to invert a binary tree on a whiteboard. We will ask you to think in front of us.
• Code you can defend. Bring something you built. We will ask why you made each decision, not what the code does.
• Debugging under observation. We give you a broken thing. Your reasoning process matters more than your speed.
• Judgement under acceleration. You will use an AI assistant in the exercise. We are watching for whether you can tell when its output is right, when it is subtly wrong, and when it should be thrown away.
• Learning velocity. What did you learn in the last six months, how did you learn it, and what did you build with it
• Communication. Explain one technical decision to someone who is not an engineer. Clients will ask you to do this for real.

QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related engineering or quantitative discipline.
• 1–3 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong internships, academic projects, or a substantial personal portfolio are considered for candidates at the lower end of that range.
• Professional working proficiency in English.

What We Value

We seek people who are:
• Ambitious, curious, and creative.
• Sincere and joyful in how they work.
• Passionate about delivering impact and creating value.
• Committed to integrity, excellence, and continuous improvement.
• Disciplined in execution, but flexible in learning.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to apply (all steps are mandatory):
• Apply on this job post on Linkedin.
• Fill the self screening form https://links.insight360.ae/Junior-Software-Engineer
• Send your CV and portfolio to: [HIDDEN TEXT] with the subject line: Junior Software Engineer Application - UAE [Your Name]

jobs.job_title: Senior Full stack Programmer - IT | Saudi Arabia
jobs.job_description:
Join a leading Saudi technology and systems integration company specializing in delivering innovative enterprise IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, networking, and digital transformation solutions to government, enterprise, and commercial customers across the Kingdom.

The Senior Full Stack Programmer will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, maintaining, and supporting enterprise web applications across front-end and back-end environments. The role requires a highly experienced software professional capable of developing scalable applications, troubleshooting complex technical issues, integrating enterprise systems, supporting production environments, and providing technical guidance in a fast-paced technology solutions environment.

Key Accountabilities:
• Design, develop, implement, and maintain high-performance enterprise web applications across front-end and back-end environments.
• Develop modern and responsive front-end applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, latest Angular, and WebAssembly.
• Develop and maintain back-end applications, services, and APIs using C# and .NET Core 9+.
• Utilize Entity Framework, ORM technologies, and appropriate Design Patterns to develop scalable, maintainable, and high-quality applications.
• Design, develop, optimize, and maintain databases using SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
• Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and application services to support enterprise systems and business requirements.
• Implement application security, authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure coding practices.
• Deploy, manage, and support applications using Docker and Kubernetes.
• Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
• Monitor application performance, identify potential issues, and resolve complex application, integration, database, performance, and production incidents.
• Plan and execute application upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and deployments while minimizing operational disruption.
• Coordinate with project managers, business stakeholders, infrastructure, cybersecurity, database, and application teams to ensure effective application delivery and issue resolution.
• Support application testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production operations, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues.
• Maintain accurate application architecture documentation, source code, configurations, API documentation, deployment procedures, and operating guidelines.
• Ensure applications can be developed, deployed, and maintained effectively within air-gapped, isolated, or restricted environments.
• Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and support to junior developers and technical team members to enhance team capabilities and development standards.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Minimum 5–7 years of experience in full-stack software development, preferably within a large-scale technology, enterprise, government, or systems integration environment.
• Strong hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, latest Angular, and WebAssembly.
• Solid experience with C#, .NET Core 9+, Entity Framework, ORM frameworks, and software Design Patterns.
• Strong experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQL, and database management.
• Hands-on experience with Telerik, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, application integration, authentication, authorization, application security, and performance optimization.
• Strong understanding of software architecture, development best practices, scalability, maintainability, and application performance.
• Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, database, performance, and production issues.
• Experience with application deployment, upgrades, migrations, configuration changes, and production support.
• Experience working within air-gapped, isolated, or restricted environments.
• Strong experience coordinating with cross-functional technical teams, project stakeholders, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and database teams.
• Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure.
• Experience providing technical guidance and mentoring to junior developers and team members is an advantage.
